title: DXF probe
description: Deterministic facts read from one DXF with ezdxf (`harness read-dxf`). Nothing is inferred from geometry. Entity handles are valid only for this conversion: a new DWG-to-DXF conversion of the same drawing may renumber them. When status is 'unreadable', only file, attempts and error are present. When status is 'partial', at least one section raised: it is absent from the document and listed in section_errors (with a blocking probe_section_failed question), and the other sections are valid. Every value is capped at file.confidence_cap (ADR-0005: libredwg gives 'medium').

dxf_version.description: Header $ACADVER, e.g. 'AC1032'. Null if unreadable or absent.

converter.description: Tool that produced this DXF from a DWG; 'none' for a DXF supplied as such.

handles_reliable.description: False when the file stores no usable entity handles (R12-era: $HANDLING 0 or missing, or no group 5 tags in a pre-R2000 file; R2000 and later always store them). Then every handle in this document is null and ezdxf's synthesized numbers are not reported. Group 5 presence is not scanned in binary DXF, where $HANDLING alone decides.

error.description: Why the file could not be read. Present only when status is 'unreadable'.

section_errors.description: Sections that raised or were skipped because a section they depend on raised (e.g. everything built on the entity scan). Present only when status is 'partial'. Each also yields a blocking probe_section_failed question.

section.description: Top-level property name that is missing (or 'scan', 'handles').

extents.description: Header $EXTMIN/$EXTMAX in drawing units, as stored (not recomputed). Null when the header holds no usable extents. Recorded only; never used to infer units.

layers.description: Layer table plus any layer used by an entity but missing from the table (defined: false).

named.description: Non-anonymous, non-xref, non-layout blocks sorted by insert_count descending then name; at most 500 rows (truncation adds a warning).

truncated.description: True when named_total exceeds the 500 rows listed.

anonymous.description: Blocks whose name starts with '*' (dimension geometry, hatches, dynamic blocks), counted, not listed. Inserts of dynamic-block copies ('*U...') are attributed to their source block through the block record's AcDbBlockRepBTag XDATA (group 1005 = source BLOCK_RECORD handle) when that resolves, else through AcDbDynamicBlockTrueName (group 1000 = source block name, as DWG converters write it) when that names an existing block.

insert_count.description: All inserts of anonymous blocks, including those also counted for a source block.

attributed_dynamic.description: Of insert_count: inserts of '*U' copies counted in their source block's insert_count.

unresolved_dynamic.description: Inserts of '*U' copies whose source block could not be resolved (a warning is raised).

path.description: Path exactly as stored in the DXF.

resolved.description: True when a file with the xref's base name exists next to the DXF, or in the folder given as xref_dir (the original drawing's folder when the DXF is a conversion). No other folder is searched.

checked.description: File names looked for in that folder.

font.description: Font file as stored; empty if none.

family.description: TrueType family from the style's ACAD XDATA; empty if none. Recorded only: it plays no part in the encoding hints.

is_shx_like.description: Font or bigfont ends in .shx. Says nothing about whether the font is installed; availability is not checked.

capital_font.description: Capital-font hint of this style (encoding.font_hint: legacy-looking style name ending in an uppercase 'H'; an approved knowledge row may fill a null). Recorded for every style, also when no encoding hint row exists. A naming convention, not a fact; null when there is no hint.

text_encoding_hints.description: Text styles that look like a legacy Vietnamese font: one row per style. The decision is encoding.font_hint(style name, font file), the same call extract_text makes (a name starting '.Vn' is TCVN3, 'VNI-' is VNI; an unknown name is tried on the font file name); only when that says nothing, an APPROVED row of knowledge/font-encodings.csv decides, with source 'knowledge_table'. Proposed rows never appear here (see the font_encoding_proposed question). A hint, not a fact: the text itself is not decoded here.

capital_font.description: As in text_styles for this style.

knowledge_pattern.description: Pattern of the first approved knowledge row that decided; null when source is font_hint.

matched.description: The style fields that carry the hint: 'name' (style name) and/or 'font' (font file name).

unreadable_objects.description: Objects ezdxf cannot interpret, never dropped silently. kind: proxy, acad_table, ole, acis (3DSOLID, BODY, REGION, *SURFACE), unknown (any other type ezdxf keeps as raw tags). Entities in modelspace, layouts and blocks are counted together; by_layer is empty for objects in the OBJECTS section and omits entities without a layer.

handles.description: First handles found (examples only); empty when file.handles_reliable is false.

unparsed_objects.description: Every OBJECTS-section object type that ezdxf keeps as raw tags (SCALE, TABLESTYLE, dynamic-block parameter objects, FIELD...), counted by type. Informational: most are harmless. Types that can carry drawing content (FIELD) are also listed in unreadable_objects and raise a question.

entities_without_layer.description: Raw-tag entities with no group 8; they are not counted on any layer (no fake layer is created). A warning is raised when above 0.

units.description: Drawing units from header $INSUNITS only. $INSUNITS is accepted only as an integral code 0..20 (negatives, floats such as 6.9, booleans, text, >20 are invalid: header_code null, raw value kept in evidence). Code 0, a missing or invalid variable, or a code outside mm/cm/m/in/ft gives 'unknown' and a blocking units_unknown question; metres are never assumed. 'unitless' is reserved and not produced in this slice. TRUST: header units alone never reach 'high' (capped at 'medium', with a non-blocking units_confirm question); 'high' is reserved for a unit confirmed by an independent check, which this slice does not implement, so confidence is never 'high' here. It drops to 'low' with a blocking question when (a) $MEASUREMENT (0 imperial, 1 metric) disagrees with the unit system of the unit (in/ft imperial; mm/cm/m metric): units_conflict; or (b) the magnitude heuristic fails: the median absolute length of the modelspace linear and aligned dimensions (group 42 actual measurement when present, else ezdxf's measurement; at least 3 needed, otherwise the check is skipped and evidence says so), converted to metres with the declared unit, is below 0.01 m or above 100 m: units_suspect, with the median, count and thresholds in evidence. The thresholds are a documented heuristic: they only raise a question and never change the unit value.

dimension_median.description: The input of the magnitude heuristic, kept whatever the declared unit (also for 'unknown'): median absolute length of the modelspace linear and aligned dimensions in DRAWING units and how many there are. Null when the dimension audit is unavailable or fewer than 3 exist. `harness grid-system` and `harness status` re-run the same 0.01 m..100 m test with the engineer's answered unit (units_answer_contradicts_evidence).

header_code.description: $INSUNITS as stored when it is a valid integral code 0..20; null when the variable is missing or invalid (see evidence).

evidence.description: What was read and which checks ran or were skipped, in plain words.

is_overall.description: The first VIEWPORT entity of a paper-space layout (its overall viewport), whatever its id (converted DWGs often store id 0), unless that first viewport has id >= 2, which marks a user viewport. Excluded from the viewport scale check.

scale.description: Paper units per model unit (0.01 is 1:100) as ezdxf computes it; null when not computable.

defined.description: False when an entity uses the layer but the layer table has no such entry.

entities.description: Entity counts kept apart on purpose: block entities appear once per definition, not once per INSERT.

insert_count.description: INSERT entities naming this block in modelspace, layouts and other blocks (a MINSERT counts once), plus those reaching it through dynamic-block copies (dynamic_insert_count).

dynamic_insert_count.description: Part of insert_count that comes from '*U' dynamic-block copies of this block.

has_attdef.description: The block definition contains ATTDEF entities.

has_attrib.description: At least one INSERT of the block carries ATTRIB entities.

dimension_audit.description: DIMENSION entities in modelspace, paper-space layouts and block definitions (layout 'block:<name>', audited once per definition, not per INSERT; in_blocks counts them and a warning is raised). text_rule: 'measured' (text empty or '<>'), 'measured_with_text' (contains '<>' plus other text), 'suppressed' (a single blank), 'override' (anything else). measured is ezdxf get_measurement() (angular: degrees). actual_measurement is the stored group 42 (angular: radians) when present; measurement_agrees is true when it equals measured (angular: converted to radians) or, for a positive DIMLFAC other than 1, measured * DIMLFAC (real files store group 42 either way), within a relative tolerance of 1e-6; it is null when either value is missing. A group 42 that equals only the unscaled geometry while a positive DIMLFAC other than 1 is in force makes an override row 'not_compared' (unclear which value the text should show). COMPARISON of override text (only text_rule 'override'): override_value (a finite plain decimal) is compared with measured * DIMLFAC for linear, aligned, radius and diameter dimensions, which are gated on DIMLUNIT = 2 (decimal; otherwise 'not_compared'); angular dimensions (angular, angular_3p) are gated on DIMAUNIT instead: 0 compares degrees, 2 grads (measured * 400/360) and 3 radians; 1 (degrees/minutes/seconds) and 4 (surveyor's units) are 'not_compared' with that reason, and DIMLUNIT is ignored for them. Ordinate dimensions, rows whose group 42 disagrees with the geometry measurement (measurement_agrees false), and rows with an unusable DIMLFAC (zero, non-finite) or DIMDEC/DIMADEC outside 0..16 are 'not_compared'. A negative DIMLFAC is a paper-space-only factor: for a modelspace dimension factor 1 is used only when group 42 is present and agrees (which proves it), otherwise 'not_compared'; in a layout or a block it is 'not_compared'. TOLERANCE: half of the displayed precision, 0.5 * 10^-DIMDEC (DIMADEC for angular, DIMDEC when DIMADEC is -1), and at least DIMRND / 2 when DIMRND is set; the override is 'override_differs' when |override_value - expected| exceeds it. DIMDEC, DIMRND, DIMLFAC, DIMLUNIT and DIMAUNIT are the effective values (entity override, else dimension style). Override text is parsed strictly after stripping MTEXT formatting: only plain decimals such as '3500' or '3500.5' are numeric; '3,500' and numbers too large to be finite are 'not_numeric'. status: 'ok' (measured shown, suppressed, or override equals expected within tolerance), 'override_differs', 'not_numeric', 'not_compared', 'error' (a row that raised; dim_type is still the real type and the message is in note). Rows are sorted: flagged first (override_differs, error), then the rest in file order (seq). At most 200 rows are listed; counts always cover every dimension. One dimension_override_differs question is raised per override_differs row of ALL rows, not just the listed ones, up to 500 questions (a warning gives the true count beyond that).

in_blocks.description: Part of total that sits in block definitions.

tolerance_rule.description: The tolerance rule in words, repeated for readers of the output.

seq.description: 1-based position of the dimension in the scan (layouts in tab order, then block definitions); identifies a row when handle is null.

layout.description: Layout name, or 'block:<name>' for a block definition.

actual_measurement.description: Group 42 as stored (angular: radians); null when absent.

expected_text_value.description: measured * DIMLFAC (angular: measured in the DIMAUNIT unit).

scales.description: Scale values kept in two separate families, never pooled (DIMSCALE 100 and viewport scale 0.01 describe the same 1:100). dimscale counts the effective DIMSCALE of every DIMENSION entity in modelspace and layouts (entity override, else its style; block-definition dimensions are left out); 0 means 'scale to viewport'. Dimension styles that no dimension uses are listed in dimstyles but do not set a flag. viewport_scales covers non-overall viewports whose scale is computable. Within a family, values equal within a relative tolerance of 1e-4 are one scale, and a value and its reciprocal (1:N and N) are treated as the same scale; every distinct raw value of a group is kept in members. multiple_scales is true when either family has more than one group.

members.description: Distinct raw values merged into this group, ascending.

question.description: Open question for the engineer. blocking: true means nothing downstream may use the affected values until answered. Entity handles in 'where' are valid only for this conversion.

where.description: Layout, entity handle, layer or header variable.
